messages:
elaine: quick heads-up - console compare mode shows per-route latency lines but when you toggle model breakdown the legend order shuffles unpredictably, making it hard to track model-specific trends across time.

rob: I've seen that. I think the underlying chart library reorders series by current visibility which causes re-mapping of colors.

mina: propose we pin legend order to the sorted list of model ids at query time and keep a stable color map derived from hashed model_id + tenant_id. That way colors persist across toggles.

elaine: also the export CSV uses the current legend order, which is confusing if the UI reorders later. We should include column headers with model_id.

alert-bot: rollout note: small perf hit observed when adding stable color mapping for large route (>50 models) in staging.

rob: optimize by caching color map computation and only generate for top-K visible models; collapse the rest into "other" bucket.

mina: agree. I'll put up a PR and add tests for stable legend and CSV header consistency.

elaine: awesome, thanks.
